headline: Red session: KSE-100 closed at 171,943.60, down 698.56pts (-0.40%) as the Iran-Israel-US Middle East conflict escalated further — the US and Iran launched their largest attacks yet on shipping, Brent crude pushed to ~$101.4/bbl. market: KSE-100 closed Thu Sep 10 at 171,943.60, down 698.56pts (-0.40%) — a fourth mostly-red session this week as Iran and the US launched their largest attacks yet on regional shipping, with Brent crude climbing to ~$101.4/bbl on fears of a broader Gulf/Hormuz disruption. Selling was broad (293 decliners vs 162 advancers of 492 traded) though the index recovered off a worse intraday low (down over 1% mid-session) to finish only modestly lower — a similar pattern to Wednesday's round-trip. Drawdown from the Jan 23 ATH (189,556) has widened to ~9.29% (from ~8.87% Wednesday) — the fastest it has approached the 10% line that would justify shifting AICF/MICF cash reserves into MZNPETF/MIIETF; worth checking daily while Hormuz/Gulf tensions stay this elevated, though it has not crossed the trigger yet. SBP's next MPC meeting is Sep 14, 2026 (4 days away) — Topline Securities' survey shows 84% of respondents expect the policy rate held at 11.5%, a second survey shows 87.5% expecting no change (14% expect a 50bps hike, 2% expect 100bps); average CPI inflation has climbed to ~10.18% in the first two months of FY27 (from 3.56% a year earlier), the main reason a hike is even debated, though a hold remains the base case given the improving external/fiscal backdrop. DRAP drug-pricing review: unchanged since Sep 4 — pharma industry associations continue opposing the proposed pricing-formula/Hardship Policy/Policy Board changes directed by the Economic Affairs minister; nothing enacted yet. GLAXO/SEARL stance unchanged (HOLD, watch into Q4). AVN — no new company announcements since the Aug 28 H1/Q2 FY26 loss filing; EXIT call unexecuted through 12 reviews now. EFERT — no new news; the Rs2/share dividend already paid Sep 3 is the same interim covered in prior reviews, not a new event; Q3 results not yet due. DATA QUALITY: stock prices refreshed normally (fetched via GitHub's raw content API, ~08:42 UTC / ~13:42 PKT, since local git could not reach github.com over the standard git protocol — same recurring connectivity pattern noted in recent reviews; a prior local commit from Sep 9's review is still unpushed and needs a retry once connectivity to github.com's git endpoint recovers). Fund NAVs (funds_updated: Aug 13) are now 28 days stale — the MUFAP scraper issue remains unresolved; ~28% of portfolio value (all 7 funds) is still being priced off a nearly month-old NAV snapshot, a growing blind spot needing a real fix.

actions.title: Avanceon — thesis still broken, EXIT call unexecuted through 12 reviews

No dividend declared. Admin/selling expenses up 45% YoY outpaced revenue growth, and a one-off 'other income' cushion from last year (Rs 162M) collapsed to Rs 77M this year, exposing weak core operating economics — real, board-confirmed deterioration, not a rumor. Now Rs 28.75 (-36.2% on cost), down ~0.8% today in a broadly red session. No earnings catalyst pending before Q3; there's no reason left to keep waiting. The Aug 25 EXIT call is unexecuted through 12 reviews now — recommend selling the entire position at market.

entries.basis: Monthly-timeframe accumulation zones for a 10-25yr horizon: where fundamentals + monthly support align to add in small portions. 'entry' = start nibbling at/below; 'add' = deeper monthly support to load more. Pakistan macro-aware (SBP 11.5%, KSE-100 off the Jan ATH). These are accumulation guides, not precise buy/sell signals — verify with your broker.
